# Notes & Papers

> Free educational portal providing authentic previous year question papers (PYQs), solved papers, board exam papers, and university examination papers across India.

- Website: https://notesandpapers.dpdns.org
- Contact: thecodinggiant@gmail.com
- Coverage: Indian Universities, State & Central School Boards, Competitive Entrance & Recruitment Examinations.

## Core Catalogs

### 1. Indian Universities (/universities)
- **University of Rajasthan (UNIRAJ / UOR Jaipur)**: Authentic past exam question papers for B.Com, B.Sc, BCA, B.A, B.Ed, M.Sc, M.Com across annual and semester systems.
- **Rajasthan Technical University (RTU Kota)**: Engineering B.Tech previous year question papers from 1st to 8th semester across CSE, ECE, EE, Civil, and Mechanical branches.

### 2. State & Central School Boards (/boards)
- **RBSE (Board of Secondary Education, Rajasthan - BSER Ajmer)**: Class 9, Class 10 (Secondary), Class 11, and Class 12 (Senior Secondary / Arts, Science, Commerce). Includes final board examination papers, model question papers, and half-yearly test papers with clean watermarks.
- **CBSE (Central Board of Secondary Education)**: Class 10 and Class 12 board examination papers, sample papers, and marking scheme solutions.
- **Open Schools & Other State Boards**: CG Open School (CGSOS), MP Board (MPBSE), UP Board (UPMSP), ICSE/ISC.

### 3. Competitive Entrance & Recruitment Exams (/exams)
- **Civil Services**: UPSC Civil Services Examination (CSE Prelims and Mains), State PSCs (MPPSC, UPPSC, RPSC).
- **Engineering & Medical Entrance**: GATE Engineering past papers with answer keys, JEE Main & Advanced, NEET UG medical entrance question papers.
- **Staff Selection & Police**: SSC CGL, CHSL, MTS, GD Constable, State Police SI & Constable recruitment tests.
- **Teaching & Eligibility**: UGC-NET (Paper 1 & Paper 2), CTET, State TETs (REET, MP-TET, UP-TET), BSTC.
- **Banking & Finance**: SBI Clerk, SBI PO, JAIIB, CAIIB, CA, CMA.

## API & Format
- Clean PDF downloads without third-party advertisements or watermarks.
- Full metadata indexing: Exam year, semester/part, subject code, language, marking scheme.
- Structured schema markup compliant with Schema.org (LearningResource, DigitalDocument, BreadcrumbList).
